overview: Significant political and international developments, including Ukrainian war in Black Sea, Pope Leo XIV returns to Vatican after cancer surgery, solar surpasses nuclear power globally for first time, NATO launches Spanish fighters after Chinese drone near Romania border, major protests erupt across France including clashes in Paris, Lyon, and Marseille.

stories.headline: Ukrainian war escalates in Black Sea with new sanctions against Russia
stories.summary: Multiple sources report active warfare in the Black Sea and escalating sanctions, while Putin and Trump discuss their positions.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV returns to Vatican after lung cancer surgery
stories.summary: Pope returns to Vatican following successful cancer operation on his lung, covered by multiple media sources.

stories.headline: Solar power surpasses nuclear power globally for first time
stories.summary: New data shows solar energy has overtaken nuclear in global capacity, with AI advancements like DeepSeek noted.

stories.headline: NATO launches Spanish fighters after Chinese drone near Romania border
stories.summary: Chinese drone again approached Romanian border, prompting NATO to deploy two Spanish fighters, escalating international tensions.

stories.headline: Massive protests erupt across France - clashes in Paris, Lyon, Marseille
stories.summary: Protests in France have escalated into clashes with police, affecting multiple major cities including Paris, Lyon, and Marseille.
